# SpeedBlip's Glassmorphism Spec

#### Course: Rapid Build With Claude Code

## SpeedBlip's Glassmorphism Spec

Every card and panel in SpeedBlip follows the Inter typography and Glassmorphism style, like below:

```react
background: rgba(255,255,255,0.6);
-webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.3);
box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.08);
border-radius: 16px; /* cards */
border-radius: 12px; /* buttons */
border-radius: 8px;  /* inputs */
```

Safari compatibility: backdrop-filter requires the -webkit-backdrop-filter prefix for Safari. Always include both lines. Without the prefix, the blur is invisible on Safari and the card renders as a flat opaque surface. When Claude Code implements this spec, confirm both lines are present in the generated CSS.

Connecting Spec to Code

These values were written into the brand guidelines once, then given to Claude Code in Chunk 1 as part of the Tailwind token setup. Every component that appeared in later chunks automatically had the right look because the tokens were already wired in.
